name: Datadog
one_liner: Datadog offers a REST API for programmatic access to its observability platform.

evidence.snippet: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header `DD-API-KEY`. For some endpoints, you also need an Application key, which uses the header `DD-APPLICATION-KEY`.
The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.

The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API. The API uses resource-oriented URLs to call the API, uses status codes to indicate the success or failure of requests, returns JSON from all requests, and uses standard HTTP response codes.
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents that support the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
